defect.rootCause: the listener claimed latestUserMessage(messages) — the LAST user-role message carrying text — but this composition appends user-role notices AFTER the user's prompt, so the claimed text was a notice and the anchored GESTURE_PATTERN never matched

fix.change: replaced the latestUserMessage claim with `claimGesture(messages)`: EVERY user-role message of the claimed batch is scanned in order for the anchored gesture (`GESTURE_PATTERN` hoisted to module scope); the first matching message is rewritten. `latestUserMessage` is deleted (no other caller).
invariantsKept: next()-first waterfall discipline: the composed decision is awaited before any rewrite, and returned unchanged on reject/absent/user-less steps or on any failure

identity-preserving rewrite: the claiming message becomes a copy with its first text block replaced (id/role/source preserved, mirroring the adopted consumeFlagFromMessage) — no other message is touched
the command path is untouched: the same activation directive constant, the same registerCommand/submit composition
negativeControlsStillGreen: a step with no user message
